tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen and page background everywhere; the dark value is flok's terminal ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised: a selected row, an open sheet, the add field's match rows, admin panels.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed: text fields, the QR code's ground, code in the admin pages.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and the divider between open and struck entries. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders on the web pages (buttons, inputs, chips); 3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: item names, titles, counts (15:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes and quantities after an item, who and when, the age of a flag, the unknown glyph (4.5:1 and up).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and struck entries only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never text a person must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: the add button, links, the selected tab, a pressed chip, the focus ring, the household switcher's current household.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill. Never literal white or black.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a selected row, the match row under the finger, a one-time secret (an invite link) shown with Copy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element of the web pages.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The mark's ink: cyan on dark grounds, W4J teal on light. White on a brand tile.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: W4J teal, the tie to w4jnl: favicon tile, avatar, the 512 tile. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: have
tokens.usage: Flag: it is there. The same value as vink's up and nt's ok. Always with the disc glyph and the word.

tokens.name: have-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a have pill or the home card's count when everything is there.

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: Flag: last one open. vink's late. Always with the half-disc glyph and the word.

tokens.name: low-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a low pill.

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: Flag: not there. vink's down. Also destructive buttons once armed (Remove, Leave). Always with the diamond glyph and the word.

tokens.name: out-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an out pill and the home card's count when something is out.

tokens.name: on-out
tokens.usage: Text on an out fill (an armed destructive button).

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Flag: nobody has said, or the flag is older than the staleness setting. ink-muted with the dashed-ring glyph; it is an absence, not a state colour.

tokens.name: list-1
tokens.usage: List colour 1, teal: the dot before a list's name and its count pill. Chosen when the list is made; the default list wears accent. Never a state: the six stay at least 15 degrees of hue from every flag colour.

tokens.name: list-2
tokens.usage: List colour 2, sky: the dot before a list's name and its count pill. Chosen when the list is made; the default list wears accent. Never a state: the six stay at least 15 degrees of hue from every flag colour.

tokens.name: list-3
tokens.usage: List colour 3, violet: the dot before a list's name and its count pill. Chosen when the list is made; the default list wears accent. Never a state: the six stay at least 15 degrees of hue from every flag colour.

tokens.name: list-4
tokens.usage: List colour 4, plum: the dot before a list's name and its count pill. Chosen when the list is made; the default list wears accent. Never a state: the six stay at least 15 degrees of hue from every flag colour.

tokens.name: list-5
tokens.usage: List colour 5, gold: the dot before a list's name and its count pill. Chosen when the list is made; the default list wears accent. Never a state: the six stay at least 15 degrees of hue from every flag colour.

tokens.name: list-6
tokens.usage: List colour 6, moss: the dot before a list's name and its count pill. Chosen when the list is made; the default list wears accent. Never a state: the six stay at least 15 degrees of hue from every flag colour.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The one shadow on the web pages: an open admin drawer and an open menu. The apps use the system's sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: pills, flag badges, chips

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: controls, the add field

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: home cards, the spot photo thumbnail, admin panels, the QR card

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: app icon tiles, the avatar

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: a list entry row on the web and the phone's overview, Family and Settings rows

tokens.name: row-h-list
tokens.usage: An entry row on a list and the add bar: the thumb's target in a shop, one height, no mode.

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: An entry row under a pointer: the Mac's list and sidebar rows.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: web controls; 44px under (pointer: coarse)

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: flag chips and tag chips on the web; 32px under (pointer: coarse)

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: a spot photo thumbnail on the home screen

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: the guest page and the admin pages: one column, left-aligned on wide screens

tokens.name: mark-min
tokens.usage: below this use the favicon tile

tokens.name: font-mono
tokens.value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: font-sans
tokens.value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: have
tokens.usage: disc

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: half disc: half a jar left

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: diamond

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: dashed ring

tokens.name: open
tokens.usage: a list entry still to get

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: a struck entry, a task done

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: the mark in text: the house alone

tokens.name: mark-narrow
tokens.usage: the mark in a narrow column

tokens.name: motion-quick
tokens.usage: A crossfade, a hover, a chip or match row arriving; the only duration under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: A row arriving or leaving, a count rolling, an armed button changing, the offline badge.

tokens.name: motion-settle
tokens.usage: Rows closing a gap after a struck row sinks; the longest thing the apps animate.
